targets.query: from(bucket: "telemetry") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "microclimate" and r._field == "temperature_c")
from(bucket: "telemetry") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "microclimate" and (r._field == "humidity_pct" or r._field == "soil_moisture_pct"))
from(bucket: "telemetry") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "microclimate" and r._field == "wind_speed_kmh")
from(bucket: "telemetry") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "microclimate" and r._field == "rainfall_mm_h")
